title: Project Title
summary: One or two sentences. This is what shows on the project card.
role: Your role on this project (e.g. Solo full-stack engineer)
problem: What was the challenge or need going in? (Short case study: use problem/approach/results. Long-form write-up: use `sections` below instead, and omit problem/approach/results entirely.)

sections.body: One or more paragraphs of prose for this section. Separate paragraphs with a blank line between them to render as distinct paragraphs.
